title: topas-rpt
description: An OpenTOPAS extension for time-resolved Monte Carlo simulation of radioactive decay chains and radioligand binding kinetics, for radiopharmaceutical therapy dosimetry. Explicit decay-chain time structure and voxelized DICOM activity maps, alongside a compartmental in-vitro binding kinetics model validated against cell viability data.
